sql: SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE ci.circuitId = 6 AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.constructorId ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1
